risk_note: RV2 money (commission versions of terminal orders). D10-1272 (FU-TERMINAL-VERSION-ROWS, option (b); BR-CALC-15 一览 terminal branch and BR-CALC-27 'including VOID / CLAWED_BACK', SPEC_REF since 3b5122e6): an order already VOID or CLAWED_BACK whose effective N or subsidy changes keeps bumping commission_version (orders, unchanged) and now gets that version's amount rows and four totals in the same transaction — rebate.ts locked branch returns a plan with only refresh (N path, same algorithm on the new N) or subsidyRefresh (subsidy-only path, previous version's shares and base copied, three totals recomputed); no status transition, history, event, ledger entry, notification, adjust candidate or clawback. Before: the version moved without rows, so after R12 / R13 restore the order figures, wallet summary (app-wide scan), bill, adjust and clawback threw 'expected commission_version K is not the current version K-1', and terminal subsidy baselines never advanced (D10-1270 ③). Readers checked (implementer + Codex money): pending-earnings / earnings / asset snapshot read ESTIMATED(PAID) / WAITING (/ CREDITED counts); bill classification takes WAITING candidates only; adjust generate / approve and clawback only CREDITED; self-rebate and withdraw-risk callers source WAITING / CREDITED orders; forfeited-shares and rule-trial are not money; notify-beneficiaries (claim-result 'expected rebate') — money r1 S1 — fixed first by B1-18kn (#3211, exclude_terminal), confirmed closed in r2 on this tree. Backfill of existing rows-less versions is FU-TERMINAL-VERSION-ROWS-BACKFILL (ops), not here. Host: tsc -b test apps/api 0; eslint / prettier 0; terminal-version-rows 12 + claim-result 35 green after the rebase; implementer before rebase: settlement + orders + commission int 511 files 3740, apps/api unit 5134.

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium). r1 fail 1×S1: a delayed claim-result notification summed a terminal order's current-version share as '预估返' (notify-beneficiaries ignored rebate_status; existing gap widened by this task) → D10-1274 split B1-18kn (#3211, landed first); r2 on the rebased tree: S1 closed, no new findings. D10-1272 ④ checklist: terminal rows never count as earned / pending / clawable / adjustable (status filters per reader), R12 / R13 restores readable with no bill difference, terminal subsidy-equal reports no longer bump and subsidy-only copies the previous shares (refreshSubsidy).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by fresh independent Claude, 3 attempts (cap). Attempt 1: n-change / subsidy / restore (7 red). r1 fail 4×S1 (same-transaction rollback; non-zero shares on subsidy-only; verbatim re-delivery — folded in as side assertions; N 801 rounding) → attempt 2 adds rollback.int (11 red). r2 fail 1×S1 (subsidy-only case could not tell refreshSubsidy from plain refresh) → D10-1273 attempt 3 adds subsidy-repriced.int (R7 600 / 300 → VOID → subsidy-only copies 600 / 300), red/3 12 red, the new case red at its own assertion with preconditions holding. Verified on throwaway copies: option (b) patch turns all 12 green; mutation 'terminal subsidy-only calls plain refresh' turns only the new case red (at the shares-equal assertion). Gate record (not counted) pass.
